title: Saltline · Jimao
description: A rain-soaked harbor FPS in about 1.4 MB. Fight robotic patrols, disable three relays and extract. Community Chinese edition of Felix Rieseberg's Claude experiment.
description_zh: 约 1.4 MB 的雨夜港口 FPS：机械巡逻、湿地倒影、三座中继与撤离任务。「几猫」中文流传版，原作为 Felix Rieseberg 的 Saltline。首次需现场生成场景，请等待开始按钮；设置内可提高画质。WASD 移动、鼠标瞄准、R 换弹、E 交互。

versions.source_note: English standalone community mirror. Original author artifact: https://claude.ai/artifact/BGY1SztrAYcJQHSsnHHGmp

versions.adaptation_note: Community Chinese edition, retained byte for byte from Megasu/jimao-3a-game. Not claimed to be identical to either the first or latest author artifact.
versions.source_note: Original author: Felix Rieseberg. Chinese archive: Megasu/jimao-3a-game. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
Based on the preserved Chinese community HTML. Original author: Felix Rieseberg.
versions.adaptation_note: Start at the medium graphics preset with 512px procedural textures to reduce first-load work. Reflections remain enabled. High and ultra presets remain available in Settings. Both received source files are preserved separately.

title: Mosswing
description: Fly through a lush procedural 3D garden with a single tap. A self-contained community game by Ayi1337, attributed by its creator to GPT-6 Astra.
description_zh: 穿过雾气与花叶，用一次次轻拍保持飞行，在林间寻找空隙。Ayi1337 发布的单文件 3D 游戏；点击或空格振翅，支持触屏。

title: London Dream Railway
title_zh: London Dream Railway · 伦敦梦幻铁路
description: A 3D toy London with miniature trains, landmarks, boats, six seasonal scenes and a train-driver view. Featured in OpenAI's Developers Showcase.
description_zh: 把伦敦放进一张 3D 玩具沙盘：小火车、大本钟、伦敦眼、游船与四季灯光。可自动游览，也可切换列车驾驶视角。OpenAI 官方展厅收录作品。

versions.source_note: Original index.html requires main.js, styles.css and Three.js. Companion source files are retained in the collection archive.

versions.adaptation_note: Bundled the original JavaScript, CSS, Three.js 0.164.1 and OrbitControls into one offline HTML. Removed the external import map; scene and interaction logic are retained.

title: Ocean Wave Simulation
title_zh: Ocean Wave Simulation · 海浪模拟
description: OpenAI's published GPT-5.2 demo: a real-time ocean with adjustable wind, waves and lighting, implemented in a single HTML file.
description_zh: OpenAI 官方公开的 GPT-5.2 单文件演示。实时海浪与天空，可调风速、浪高与光照，拖动视角看水面起伏。

versions.source_note: Unmodified HTML from OpenAI's official gpt-5-coding-examples repository.

title: Solar System Explorer
title_zh: Solar System Explorer · 太阳系漫游
description: Explore animated planetary orbits and inspect planets in OpenAI's published single-file GPT-5.2 solar-system demo.
description_zh: OpenAI 官方 GPT-5.2 演示。穿行星空、查看行星轨道与信息，控制时间流速，在一个 HTML 里漫游太阳系。

versions.source_note: Unmodified HTML from OpenAI's official gpt-5-coding-examples repository.

title: Nebula Drifter
description: OpenAI's published GPT-5.2 space dogfight demo with glowing trails, enemy waves and responsive controls, entirely in one HTML file.
description_zh: OpenAI 官方 GPT-5.2 太空空战演示。驾驶飞船迎击敌机波次，在霓虹拖尾和爆炸粒子中突围。按游戏内提示操控。

versions.source_note: Unmodified HTML from OpenAI's official gpt-5-coding-examples repository.

title: Festival Lights Show
title_zh: Festival Lights Show · 音乐灯光秀
description: An audio-reactive LED light wall from OpenAI's official GPT-5 examples. Mix colors, patterns, intensity and a built-in demo beat.
description_zh: OpenAI 官方 GPT-5 音乐灯光秀。用内置节拍点亮 LED 点阵，自由组合色彩与动态图案，调节速度、亮度和网格密度。

versions.source_note: Unmodified HTML from OpenAI's official gpt-5-coding-examples repository.
